title: Raku and Horsehair Firing with Peter Syak
source_quote: Raku and Horsehair Firing with Peter! Each summer the guild meets at Peter Syak's studio for a full day of Raku and Horsehair firing.
evidence_sentence: The events page describes an annual summer raku and horsehair firing at Peter Syak's studio for Guild members.
evidence_quote: Each summer the guild meets at Peter Syak's studio for a full day of Raku and Horsehair firing.
summary: Guild members can participate in an annual summer raku and horsehair firing at Peter Syak's studio, including a potluck feast. Registration details are sent to members before the event.
how_to_join: Information for registration will be sent to Guild members prior to the event.
